findings.summary: The error state is a bare left-adjusted Text with no icon or retry affordance, inconsistent with a polished error UX and giving the user no way to recover.
findings.fix: Wrap in a centered Column with an error icon (Icons.error_outline, color scheme.error), the message text centered, and a FilledButton/OutlinedButton that calls ref.invalidate(kpiEvaluationFormProvider(widget.evaluationId)) to retry.

findings.summary: The validation-errors Card sets color: errorContainer but its child Text widgets inherit the default onSurface color, which can fail contrast on the errorContainer surface in dark theme.
findings.fix: Set the title and bullet Text colors to Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onErrorContainer so text reads correctly against the errorContainer background in both light and dark modes.

findings.summary: Section titles like 'الأهداف — 40 درجة' use a bespoke hardcoded TextStyle(fontSize:17, w900) instead of the shared MobileSectionHeader widget used elsewhere in the design system.
findings.fix: Replace the raw Text with MobileSectionHeader(title: 'الأهداف — 40 درجة') so section headings match the established typography (titleMedium) across pages.

findings.summary: The employee name uses a hardcoded TextStyle(fontSize:20, w900) rather than a theme text style, bypassing the design-system typography scale.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) instead of the literal fontSize:20 style.

findings.summary: The _chip helper wraps every label in a bare Material Chip, whereas the design system provides MobileStatusPill (radius 99) for status/role labels, producing inconsistent chip styling.
findings.fix: For the stage/role/locked/status labels, route recognized values through MobileStatusPill (e.g. locked/finalized) and keep Chip only for genuinely freeform text, so status chips match the shared pill styling.

findings.summary: Sub-card headings such as 'تفاصيل الحضور المحسوبة تلقائيًا' and 'متطلبات الاعتماد غير المكتملة' use ad-hoc TextStyle(w900) with no size, diverging from the shared heading typography.
findings.fix: Standardize these inline card titles on Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) for consistent weight/size.

findings.summary: The score Slider has no Semantics label describing which criterion it edits, so screen-reader users hear only a numeric value with no context.
findings.fix: Wrap the Slider in Semantics(label: 'درجة معيار ${criterion.name}', value: value.toStringAsFixed(1), child: ...) or pass semanticFormatterCallback to announce the criterion name.

findings.summary: The general-note and appeal TextField use the default OutlineInputBorder() instead of the design system input radius of 16, so these inputs have square-ish corners inconsistent with themed inputs.
findings.fix: Rely on the theme's InputDecorationTheme (drop the explicit border: OutlineInputBorder()) or set OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)) to match the 16px input radius.
